name: scraper-extension
description: Collect saved places, saved posts, and conversations using your signed-in Chrome profile.

interface.longDescription: Collect Google Maps saved-list entries, Instagram saved collections, and Instagram and WhatsApp conversations through your local Chrome session. Requires Chrome, Node.js 22+, the bundled Chrome extension and native host. Website adapters are experimental and require live verification.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me collect information from a saved list or conversation in my browser.
